tools.name: hubstaff_resolve_task_url
tools.description: Resolve a Hubstaff Tasks board URL (tasks.hubstaff.com) to find the corresponding task via the API. The Tasks board uses different IDs than the API, so this tool parses the URL and searches across projects to find the task. Example URL: https://tasks.hubstaff.com/app/organizations/53835/projects/1110272/tasks/17861493

url.description: A Hubstaff Tasks board URL, e.g. https://tasks.hubstaff.com/app/organizations/53835/projects/1110272/tasks/17861493

tools.name: hubstaff_find_task_by_name
tools.description: Search for a task by name or keyword across all task board projects (or within a specific project). Useful when you know the task name but not its API ID.

query.description: Task name or keyword to search for

project_id.description: Optional: API project ID to search within. If omitted, searches all projects.

tools.name: hubstaff_get_board_view
tools.description: Get a full kanban board view of a task board project, showing all columns and tasks organized by column. Use hubstaff_tasks_list_projects or hubstaff_resolve_task_url first to get the API project ID.

project_id.description: The API project ID (use hubstaff_tasks_list_projects or hubstaff_resolve_task_url to find it)
